​Chronobiology meets metabolic health: When we eat may matter just as much as what we eat.

​A recent study published in Clinical Gastroenterology and Hepatology links out-of-hours, late-night eating with increased risks of MASLD and cirrhosis, pointing toward our internal circadian rhythms as a key metabolic driver.

​As clinical diagnostics and preventive healthcare evolve, understanding how lifestyle timing intersects with organ health becomes increasingly critical. Great food for thought by Erwin Loh on the nuances of metabolic wellness.
